reason: The north-only, trimmed specification is arbitrary, but I re-ran the model on the full sample and in each region. With pre-period controls the supplier_diversity coefficient is near zero and insignificant every time (full sample 0.05–0.06, p≈0.82–0.84; regions p>0.2). Only the unadjusted regressions show a positive coefficient. 'No effect' therefore holds up, though the report should say it means no detectable effect.
